name: cio_asks_tracked_build_admission_lq3156_20261114
comment: ANCHOR: LQ3156_TRACKED_BUILD_ADMISSION — GET /api/v2/cio/asks/tracked answered 200 UNKNOWN forever because the
serve-last-good SWR build ran cio_ask_api.handle on a background thread with no request identity: the operator gate
refused it 403 on every build (371 failures, tracked:null) and the route's 403 contract was swallowed into a 200.
The fix snapshots the request identity on the request thread (cio_ask_api.snapshot_ctx), passes it into the build,
and answers a non-operator with the handler's real 403 BEFORE any build starts. Hermetic: no DB/Valkey/server.
